claims.text: Chronic severe 2/2 MR (C/D) + HFrEF: strd HF GDMT (ACEi, ARBs, BBs, aldosterone antagonists and/or sacubitril/valsartan; biventricular pacing as indicated).
claims.quote: Patients with chronic severe secondary MR (Stages C and D) and HF with reduced LVEF should receive standard GDMT for HF, including ACE inhibitors, ARBs, beta blockers, aldosterone antagonists, and/or sacubitril/valsartan, and biventricular pacing as indicated.
